files_summary.weather.json: Enriched weather DB: 35 real US ICAO weather stations (KJFK, KLAX, KORD, etc.) and 24 by_location records keyed by 'lat,lng' (real US city coords) plus a default fallback. Each record has current conditions, 7-day daily forecast (2026-06-24..06-30), 24-hour hourly forecast, and 0-2 weather alerts (Heat Advisory, Severe Thunderstorm Warning, Flash Flood Watch, Excessive Heat Warning, etc.) spanning moderate/severe/minor severity for late-June realism.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: weather_get_current_weather
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest available observed weather conditions for the provided U.S. latitude/longitude, such as temperature, sky/conditions, humidity, wind, and related observation metadata. It refuses requests with a missing or malformed coordinate pair, or coordinates that fall outside supported U.S. coverage (states, territories, and coastal waters). It also refuses locations where current observations can’t be resolved from available reporting sources.

location.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City. Must be within US boundaries including states, territories (PR, VI, AS, GU, MP), and coastal waters.

tool_schemas.name: weather_get_weather_forecast
tool_schemas.description: Returns a multi-day forecast for the provided U.S. latitude/longitude, with day and night periods for each forecast day up to the requested horizon. It refuses requests with a missing or malformed coordinate pair, coordinates outside supported U.S. coverage (states, territories, and coastal waters), or a days value outside 1–7. It also refuses locations where forecast grid/zone data can’t be resolved for the given point.

location.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City. Must be within US boundaries including states, territories (PR, VI, AS, GU, MP), and coastal waters.

days.description: Number of days to forecast (1-7, default 7). Each day includes both day and night periods.

tool_schemas.name: weather_get_hourly_forecast
tool_schemas.description: Returns an hour-by-hour forecast for the provided U.S. latitude/longitude for the requested number of hours, including hourly temperature, conditions, and precipitation probability. It refuses requests with a missing or malformed coordinate pair, coordinates outside supported U.S. coverage (states, territories, and coastal waters), or an hours value outside 1–48. It also refuses locations where the hourly forecast source can’t be mapped to the given point.

location.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City. Must be within US boundaries including states, territories (PR, VI, AS, GU, MP), and coastal waters.

hours.description: Number of hours to forecast (1-48, default 24). Provides temperature, conditions, and precipitation probability for each hour.

tool_schemas.name: weather_get_weather_alerts
tool_schemas.description: Returns currently active weather alerts affecting the specified area, optionally filtered by severity, including watches, warnings, and advisories. It refuses requests with a missing location, a location that is neither a valid coordinate pair nor a recognized two-letter state/territory code, or a severity value outside the supported set. It also refuses locations that can’t be mapped to a supported alert area.

location.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees OR 2-letter state/territory code. Examples: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City, 'CA' for California, 'PR' for Puerto Rico. Valid state codes: AL, AK, AS, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, DC, FL, GA, GU, HI, ID, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MN, MS, MO, MT, NE, NV, NH, NJ, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, OK, OR, PA, PR, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VT, VI, VA, WA, WV, WI, WY, MP, PW, FM, MH.

severity.description: Filter by alert severity: 'extreme' (life-threatening), 'severe' (significant threat), 'moderate' (possible threat), 'minor' (minimal threat), or 'all' (default - shows all active alerts).

tool_schemas.name: weather_find_weather_stations
tool_schemas.description: Returns a distance-ordered list of nearby weather observation stations for the provided U.S. latitude/longitude, up to the requested limit. It refuses requests with a missing or malformed coordinate pair, coordinates outside supported U.S. coverage (states, territories, and coastal waters), or a limit outside 1–20. It also refuses locations where nearby stations cannot be determined from available station indexes.

location.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City. Must be within US boundaries including states, territories (PR, VI, AS, GU, MP), and coastal waters.

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (1-20, default 10). Stations are returned ordered by distance from the specified location.

tool_schemas.name: weather_get_local_time
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current local time at the provided latitude/longitude, based on the location’s time zone. It refuses requests with a missing or malformed coordinate pair, or coordinates that can’t be mapped to a known time zone. It also refuses locations outside the supported U.S. coverage when a local time zone can’t be resolved.

location.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City.

metadata.name: SkyLattice Weather Hub
metadata.description: Provides U.S. location-based current conditions, hourly and multi-day forecasts, severe weather alerts, nearby station lookup, and local time data via a unified API.
